title: Contract for the Purchase and Installation of a Standby Generator at Fire Station #5 located at 6375 Walden Rd., Beaumont, TX 77707

onscreen_lines.desc: BASE BID (As Specified in Scope of Work) For Furnishing All Labor, Materials, Equipment, and Supervision Necessary to Install a new Standby Generator - 60 kW at 120 / 208 volts ac 3 phase, .8 pf. natural gas fueled pad mounted generator. Transfer switch shall be rated NEMA 1, Service Entrance Rated, at 400 amps, 120/208 vac, 3phase. Bid shall include remote annunciator and start up service for generator at Fire Station #5 located at 6375 Walden Road Beaumont, Texas 77707.
